name: voice-input
title: VoiceInput
description: Push-to-talk that transcribes on device: the mic is the variant's key, a waveform drawn in the variant, then the transcript with Use and Retry.
docs: Audio capture is not bundled: pass `recorder` (expo-audio, react-native-audio-record or your own module) with `start()`, `stop()` → WAV/PCM bytes and `onLevel()`. Without one a simulated recorder runs, so the mock and the playground just work.
limits: iPhone only for now (Apple SpeechAnalyzer). The app passes in the recorder (for example expo-audio); without one nothing is recorded.
